👨‍💻 Developer: Md. Abu Rise Zunaed

PAC-MAN Arcade Edition

An authentic arcade recreation with polyphonic synthesized audio, original ghost AI behaviors (Blinky, Pinky, Inky, Clyde), high scores, and smooth hardware rendering.

Lead Developer:
Md. Abu Rise Zunaed

Supported Platforms:
• iPhone / iPad: Tap Safari Share button ➔ "Add to Home Screen" to install full native fullscreen app.
• Android: Tap Chrome menu ➔ "Install App" to install.
• Mac / Windows: Play in browser or download desktop package.

Controls:
• Arrow Keys or WASD
• Space or Enter to Start / Restart
• P to Pause, M to Toggle Mute
